# BD × AI Lab — MDL×DCC / AIM³ public map

> Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič, developed through the AIM³ human–AI collaboration framework. The recurring kernel is MDL×DCC: Minimum Description Length as a structure/quality sensor plus Directed/Dynamic Complexity Control as a governance/search layer. The pattern is explored across chess, TSP/route planning, compression, audio, genome/FASTA, trading, Sudoku, crosswords, mathematical arenas, history/civilization, and AC/CCH consciousness research.

## Start here
- [Complete Site Index & Mindmap](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.html): Exhaustive color-coded index and expandable visual mindmap of all 268 HTML pages detected in i.txt.
- [Home / 8ZC Chess](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/): Main chess and site entrance.
- [BD × AI Lab](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/): Portfolio and public project hub.
- [AIM³](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3.html): AI Management of Mind & Memory.
- [AIM³ RHP](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHP.html): Multi-agent brainstorming / Resonance Hybrid Protocol.
- [AIM³ RHPr](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHPr.html): Prompting / anti-lock retrieval protocol.
- [8Z Reasoning](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_8Z_Reasoning.html): Reasoning and cross-domain-transfer principles.

## Machine-readable discovery
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/sitemap.xml): Curated canonical/key public URLs for crawlers.
- [robots.txt](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/robots.txt): Allows crawling and points to sitemap.

Notes: `i.html` is exhaustive; `sitemap.xml` is curated and excludes most archive/model-variant/private-looking pages. Public URLs use `/bd/` for the BD folder. The index is printable: browser print opens branches and uses a white layout.

## Complete visual index and printable export
- [Complete site index + expandable mindmap](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.html): Full crawlable map of every HTML page listed in i.txt, with search, colored sections, collapsible chapters, and mobile menu controls.
- [Printable complete site index PDF](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.pdf): White-background PDF export of the complete site index for offline review and printing.
